title: Can a steering vector detect when a model is being jailbroken in real time?

original_idea.body: Use a refusal/harm concept probe as a real-time internal monitor during jailbreak attempts, classify attempted-harmful vs benign at generation time, measure detection AUC across jailbreak families vs a keyword baseline.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: representation-level jailbreak detection addresses a concrete adversarial-robustness threat.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Pre-extracted probe + public jailbreak datasets, AUC vs baseline; clear inherited methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (detection AUC across families vs baseline).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly red-team/monitoring on open models, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Probe-based jailbreak monitoring is active; real-time framing may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Real-time per-family probe detection may be open.
